evals.name: public-page-audit
evals.prompt: Audit this public Apple App Store listing, cite observed evidence, list evidence gaps, and propose compliant metadata experiments.
assertions: Uses Apple App Store terminology only
Includes direct source links and an evidence gaps section

evals.name: competitor-comparison
evals.prompt: Compare this iPhone app with three named App Store competitors and recommend positioning changes.
assertions: Does not put competitor names in Keywords

evals.name: visual-assets
evals.prompt: Review the screenshot and app preview strategy for this App Store product page.
assertions: Uses current Apple screenshot and preview specifications
Provides a message sequence and test hypotheses

evals.name: approved-handoff
evals.prompt: Prepare an ASO handoff after I separately approve Description, Promotional Text, Keywords, and What's New.
assertions: Does not approve the handoff before all four approvals
Keeps App Name and Subtitle as recommendations only

evals.name: apple-only-boundary
evals.prompt: Optimize my iOS App Store metadata and explain all field limits.
assertions: Keywords are limited to 100 UTF-8 bytes
Contains no Google Play limits or terminology
Does not claim speculative ranking factors are Apple-confirmed
